comments.note: FU-1 (DumpTest.php::testDumpNodeNullInnerInfo): Test fixture uses <hr> (a void/self-closing element that naturally has no HDOM_INFO_INNER set), which is semantically ideal for this scenario. The assertion assertStringContainsString(' NULL ', $result) correctly captures the intended behavior. No issues.

FU-2 (Node.php dump_node() is_array guard at line 127): The nested is_array($v2) guard with implode(', ', $v2) fallback is architecturally sound. HDOM_INFO_SPACE is a known 3-element array; the guard handles the general case cleanly without hardcoding structure knowledge. The implode output is appropriate for a debug string — no precision lost and no PHP warning emitted.

FU-3 (Parser.php load() null signature): The union type string|null on the method signature and the null-coalescing $str ??= '' at the top of the method body is the idiomatic PHP 8 pattern. It correctly defers null-to-empty-string normalization before any downstream use, keeping the rest of the method unchanged. Public API is backward-compatible.

FU-4 (Node.php __get() is_bool guard at line 512): The is_bool($val) short-circuit before convert_text() is the correct minimal fix. The boolean is returned directly (the calling code relies on truthiness for no-value attributes like 'checked', 'nowrap', 'selected'). This is consistent with __isset() and __set() behavior — attributes can be stored as boolean true for value-less HTML attributes.

FU-5 (TextConverter.php isUtf8() >= 128): The >= 128 comparison (vs. the previous > 128) correctly includes ASCII byte 128 (0x80) in the multi-byte detection path. Byte 0x80 is a valid continuation byte prefix — without this fix the loop would have silently passed over it, allowing false positives. The logic correctly returns false for bare continuation bytes (range 128–191) in the outer else branch.

FU-6 (ParserTest.php testForceTagsClosedFalse): The try/finally pattern with restore_error_handler() in the finally block is the correct approach — it guarantees handler restoration even if the constructor throws. Removing the $previous variable and using restore_error_handler() directly simplifies the code and eliminates the risky-test flag. The assertion on $deprecationTriggered after the finally block is correctly scoped.

Minor style observation (non-blocking): dump_node() closing quote for HDOM_INNER_INFO is inconsistent — the 'set' branch closes with .' \'' (includes closing quote) while the NULL branch closes the string without a trailing single-quote character. This appears to be intentional (NULL is a sentinel not a quoted string value), but a brief inline comment would aid future readers.
